outcomeNote: Mishna records a dispute between Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים: לֹא יִמָּנֶה יִשְׂרָאֵל עִם הַכֹּהֵן לַבְּכוֹר, וּבֵית הִלֵּל מַתִּירִין, וַאֲפִילּוּ גּוֹי.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Beit Shammai say: An Israelite cannot be counted with the priest to» partake of a blemished «firstborn. And Beit Hillel deem» it «permitted» for him to partake of it, «and» they deem it permitted «even» for «a gentile» to partake of a blemished firstborn.

moves.summary: Beit Shammai forbid an Israelite to be counted with a priest for a blemished firstborn
moves.about: whether a non-priest Israelite (and even a gentile) may be counted with a priest to eat a blemished firstborn

moves.summary: Beit Hillel permit it, even for a gentile

edges.cueHe: בית שמאי אומרים ... ובית הלל מתירין
edges.about: whether a non-priest Israelite (and even a gentile) may be counted with a priest to eat a blemished firstborn

positions.claim: an Israelite may not be counted with a priest to eat a blemished firstborn
an Israelite may be counted, and even a gentile may eat of it
